title: [BUG] FVM git-cache migration can destroy an unrelated repository
notes: Opened and closed on 2026-08-19, so it never sat in the open triage queue. Destructive git-cache migration against unrelated repos (ancestor discovery, gitfile redirect, inherited GIT_DIR from hooks/worktrees). Fixed by PR #1060 in FVM 4.1.4: classify only standalone caches FVM owns, and scrub repository-scoped git env vars when spawning git/flutter/dart.
